_comment: Offline fixture source. Enabled via ENABLED_SOURCES=sample so you can see
the whole pipeline - scoring, badges, distance, notifications - working
before you have eBay keys or a live marketplace feed. Each fixture carries
its own comp set, so no network call is made for these.
minutesAgo/offsetMi/bearingDeg are resolved against your current location
at poll time, which is why the fixtures always look freshly listed.

listings.title: EVGA RTX 3080 10GB - no display, for parts or repair
listings.description: Card powers on, fans spin, but no display on any port. Was working then died during a game. No artifacts before it went. Selling as is.

listings.title: LG 65" OLED C1 TV - cracked screen, everything else works
listings.description: Kids threw a controller. Cracked panel with lines but sound and smart features all work. Boards are perfect. $60 obo.

listings.title: MacBook Pro 16 2019 - cracked screen, no hard drive
listings.description: i9, 16GB. Screen is cracked in the corner and there is no SSD installed. Boots to recovery over the network fine. Battery is fine.

listings.title: Marantz 2270 receiver - one channel out, unrestored
listings.description: Estate find. Left channel drops out and it hums. Never been recapped. Faceplate is clean, wood case included.

listings.title: PS5 disc edition - no video, broken hdmi port
listings.description: Console turns on, fan runs, but nothing on screen. Pretty sure the HDMI port is bent, kid tripped over the cable. Controller included.
